item.title: Rallying Cry – September 19, 2026
item.description: From rescuing 30 children from an illegal orphanage to brain-inspired computers that could run as efficiently as a human brain, today’s good news also includes California offering reparations to oil drilling victims and Nepal’s Gen Z leading the charge against climate disasters.
